help.title: Quick guide
help.body:
1. Choose a password-file location.
2. Choose an extraction folder.
3. Drop archives from Finder.
4. Add passwords with Return or import text.
5. Press Start.

Red marks the password currently being tested. The password list is saved automatically in the selected text file. You can change its location at startup or under Password file. Spaces, tabs and paragraph breaks separate imported passwords. Each archive gets its own output folder. No match can also indicate a damaged archive. For multipart archives, add only the first volume and keep all parts together.
